headline: How many transfers are you on at this point of the season?
body: Hi, I am feeling bad about being stuck on 1 transfer this week, how many has everyone else banked? I feel like most people are on 1/2 this week with a few chnages that need to be made. No need for a minus 4 yet though thankfully...   submitted by   /u/ForwardPassApologist [link]   [comments]
